api.eyebrow: For developers, RegTech, and AI agents
api.lede: Brubru is a vertical EU data provider. Our REST API now spans every EU institution, body and agency: 935 endpoints across 88 folders, one folder per institution. You get real-time access to 28,500+ adopted laws, 1,200+ legislative procedures, live consultation feedback, commissioner agendas, AI legislative-outcome predictions, the unified EU institutional calendar, the Transparency Register, and the legal-text intelligence layer that powers Brubru's own chatbot and Amendator. Brubru itself is the first user of its own API.

quickstart.intro: Get your first API response in under two minutes.
quickstart.step1: Sign up at brubru.beresol.eu/subscription. Your API key will appear in your account settings within minutes.
quickstart.step3: Every endpoint returns the same paginated envelope. Extract the data array to iterate over results. Check has_more and next_page to paginate.

examples.intro: Copy-paste examples for the most common integrations.
examples.mcpDescription: Brubru exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, or any MCP-compatible AI agent to give your assistant live EU legislative intelligence.

endpoints.brusselsLobbies: Every Brussels-based EU Transparency Register organisation, ranked, with the news and updates each one publishes on its own website. Filters by organisation type, policy interest and lobbying spend; news-availability flags per org.
endpoints.catalanTranslations: 8,710 binding EU laws translated into Catalan (MIT). Open data - no API key required. Filter by doc_type, category, engine; full-text search.
endpoints.laws: 28,500+ adopted EU laws. Filters by CELEX, doc type, policy area, publication date, full-text search.
endpoints.procedures: 1,200+ legislative files from proposal to adoption. Filters by OEIL reference, lead committee, rapporteur, last-update.
endpoints.consultations: Live stakeholder contributions from the EC Have Your Say portal. Paginated with country and user-type aggregates.
endpoints.commissioners: Live calendar items for all 27 college members. Name resolution is accent-insensitive.
endpoints.predictions: AI-predicted outcome probabilities and timeline for any ongoing EU legislative procedure (adopted, rejected, withdrawn or pending), with a confidence score and an uncertainty range.
endpoints.recitalMap: TF-IDF cosine mapping of recitals to articles for any law. Top-3 recitals per article.
endpoints.definedTerms: Article 3/4-style definitions dictionary. Hover-ready for annotating legal text.
endpoints.resolveRefs: Plain text in, structured CELEX citations out. Optional HTML annotation.
endpoints.resolveAliases: Resolve human names (GDPR, DSA, AI Act, CBAM, ...) to CELEX. 680+ aliases.
endpoints.tenderDocs: One full EU funding-application template by id: every section, AI co-writer prompt seeds, comply targets, reference-doc bundle and Grant Agreement URLs. 19 templates across 8 programmes (EIC, Erasmus+, Digital Europe, CERV, LIFE, Creative Europe, CEF, ESF+).
endpoints.eeas: Press material, publications, events, tenders and topic pages from the European External Action Service, the EU’s diplomatic service. The 352 officials come from who-is-who.
endpoints.eurostatSeries: One Eurostat dataset fetched live: JSON-stat 2.0 payload, parsed dimensions, sample observations and Eurostat's last-update date. 12 curated sport + fitness-relevant health series (physical activity, BMI, household sport spend, cultural employment) plus any Eurostat code on the detail endpoint.
endpoints.extract: Point it at any EU institutional URL: it detects the platform, fetches through the right anti-bot path, and returns structured items with the 5-datapoint contract.
endpoints.social: Recent posts from mapped EU accounts (institutions, MEPs, Commissioners, EU-affairs journalists) across the open platforms, newest first.

auth.description: Every /api/v1/* endpoint requires an API key. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key> (recommended) or X-API-Key: <key>. Keys are minted by Brubru's admin team for Professional subscribers. Rate limit is 60 requests per minute per key.
auth.note: X-API-Key is also accepted for curl-friendly scripts. Bearer is the default for Postman, OpenAPI tooling, and SDKs.

envelope.description: Every paginated endpoint returns the same shape. Partners can code once against the envelope and swap datasets by changing the path.

errors.ok: Success. See X-RateLimit-Remaining for your remaining calls in the window.
errors.forbidden: Key valid but the owner is not on the Professional tier.
errors.rateLimited: Rate limit exceeded. Respect the Retry-After header.
errors.upstream: Upstream EU portal temporarily unavailable (e.g. Have Your Say, Commission calendar).
errors.envelopeNote: Error responses use a canonical envelope: { error, reason_code, request_id }. Every response also carries an X-Request-Id header for support traceability.

fullDocs.lede: The full API reference lives on its own microsite: introduction, authentication, response envelope, errors, rate limits, every endpoint documented with parameters and curl examples, a matrix of every EU institution we ingest from, a glossary for every acronym, role-specific use cases, and a dated changelog.

mcp.lede: Connect Brubru to any MCP-capable client - Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini and more. Same API key, same euro balance. Most of the time you only need one tool: ask_brubru.

what.title: What is MCP?
what.body1: Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets AI assistants discover and call external tools. Brubru runs an MCP server so any compatible client - Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, ChatGPT custom GPTs - can ask Brubru about EU policy, legislation, calendar events, MEPs and committees without you copy-pasting context.
what.body2: Authentication is by your Brubru API key. Each tool call debits your euro balance against the same pricing as the REST API. Tools that need broader access (e.g. read:ep, read:commission) only work if the key was minted with that scope - your blast radius is exactly the scope set you chose.

vscode.body: If you use Anthropic's Claude Cowork or the Claude Code VS Code extension, Brubru can be added as an MCP server.

vscode.s2: Paste the JSON below into the user or project MCP config.
vscode.s3: Reload the window - the six Brubru tools appear in the assistant's tool list.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT (custom GPT)
chatgpt.body: ChatGPT doesn't speak MCP natively as of May 2026, but you can wire Brubru in via a custom GPT Action.
chatgpt.bodyMoaning: You'll need a ChatGPT Plus or Teams account to create custom GPTs. The setup takes about three minutes.
chatgpt.s1: In ChatGPT, go to Explore GPTs → Create.
chatgpt.s2: In Configure → Actions, add a new action.
chatgpt.s3: Set the URL below as the action endpoint and Authentication = Bearer Token with your Brubru key.
chatgpt.s4: Add a brief instruction telling the GPT it can call Brubru's MCP tools for EU policy questions.

gemini.title: Gemini (and other LLMs)
gemini.body: Gemini's tool-calling API can hit Brubru's HTTP endpoint directly. Provide the endpoint URL and the Authorization: Bearer header in your Gemini SDK setup; the tool schema mirrors the MCP `tools/list` response.
gemini.bodySecondary: If you use a different provider - Mistral, Llama-based tools, or your own agent framework - point it at the same /api/mcp endpoint. The protocol is open JSON-RPC; no Brubru-specific SDK needed.

tools.lede: Six tools, mapped 1:1 to the relevant /api/v1/* endpoints. Each call is metered at €0.005 against your balance.

pricing.title: Pricing reminder
pricing.body: Brubru's MCP tool calls are priced the same way as the REST API:
pricing.b1: Every tool call costs €0.005 (5 000 micro-euros), debited from your euro balance.
pricing.b2: No free signup credit; minimum top-up is €1. Public sandbox covers evaluators.
pricing.b3: If a tool call crashes (server error), the cost is refunded automatically.
pricing.b4: Per-key scope check still applies - a key with only read:laws can't call ask_brubru (needs read:knowledge).

askAnything.title: Ask Brubru Anything
askAnything.content: Type questions about EU legislation, MEPs, policy areas, or paste documents for analysis. Brubru is available in 6 languages.

exploreTools.title: Explore Brubru Tools
exploreTools.content: Access specialised tools: draft amendments, check compliance, track tenders, and monitor your EU bubble.

chooseLanguage.title: Choose Your Language
chooseLanguage.content: Brubru is available in English, French, Dutch, Spanish, Catalan, and Italian. Select your preferred language.

yourQuestion.title: Your Question Here
yourQuestion.content: Type questions about EU policy, legislation, or institutions. Press Enter to send or Shift+Enter for a new line.

uploadDocuments.title: Upload Documents
uploadDocuments.content: Upload PDFs for compliance checking, summarisation, or analysis. Brubru will reference them in responses.

exampleQuestions.title: Example Questions
exampleQuestions.content: Not sure where to start? Click any example to try it. These are curated by EU policy experts.

selectText.title: Select Legislative Text
selectText.content: Choose the EU legislative document you want to amend. Search by title, CELEX number, or procedure reference.

draftAmendment.title: Draft Your Amendment
draftAmendment.content: Write amendments using standard European Parliament formatting. Changes are tracked automatically.

aiAssistant.title: AI Drafting Assistant
aiAssistant.content: Get AI-powered suggestions for your amendments. Brubru helps ensure legal consistency and clarity.

export.title: Export Your Work
export.content: Export amendments in Akoma Ntoso XML (official EP format) or Word for sharing with colleagues.

personalisedFeed.title: Your Personalised Feed
personalisedFeed.content: Real-time updates from 15+ EU institutional sources including Parliament, Commission, and Council.

filterFeed.title: Filter Your Feed
filterFeed.content: Filter by institution, policy area, document type, or date range to find exactly what matters to you.

trackTrends.title: Track Trends
trackTrends.content: Monitor legislative activity patterns, voting trends, and policy developments over time.

lawDatabase.title: EU Law Database
lawDatabase.content: Search through EU regulations, directives, and decisions. Filter by policy area, date, or legal status.

uploadDocument.title: Upload Your Document
uploadDocument.content: Upload your policy document, contract, or internal rules for automated compliance gap analysis.

complianceReport.title: Compliance Report
complianceReport.content: View detailed gap analysis with specific article references and actionable recommendations.

findTenders.title: Find EU Tenders
findTenders.content: Filter tenders from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) by sector, contract value, deadline, and location.

browseOpportunities.title: Browse Opportunities
browseOpportunities.content: View matching tenders with key details: contracting authority, deadline, estimated value, and requirements.

matchScoring.title: AI Match Scoring
matchScoring.content: Each tender shows an AI-calculated relevance score based on your profile and past interests.
